q: By the night when it settles
v.s: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
v.c: and the night when it falls still!

q: Your Rabb has neither forsaken you
(These verses were revealed to console Rasulullaah ﷺ when the Mushrikeen taunted him because he had not received revelation for sometime.)
v.s: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
v.c: Your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ has not abandoned you, nor has He become hateful ˹of you˺.

q: The Aakhirah is certainly much better for you than this world
(so do not worry about the taunts and difficulties of this world because they will increase your rewards in the Aakhirah).
v.s: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
v.c: And the next life is certainly far better for you than this one.

q: Your Rabb shall soon give you
v.s: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
v.c: And ˹surely˺ your Lord will give so much to you that you will be pleased.

q: (Allaah shall continue to bless you with His bounties just as He did in the past. For example,)
Did He not find you orphaned
(when your father passed away before your birth and your mother when you were only six)
(when your grandfather and uncle cared for you with great affection afterwards)?
v.s: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
v.c: Did He not find you as an orphan then sheltered you?

q: Did He not find you uninformed
v.s: And He found you lost and guided [you],
v.c: Did He not find you unguided then guided you?

q: Did He not find you poor
(when the wealthy lady Khadeeja proposed to marry you and you accepted)?
v.s: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
v.c: And did He not find you needy then satisfied your needs?

q: do not be harsh with the orphan...
v.s: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
v.c: So do not oppress the orphan,

q: (because they need your help just as much as you also once needed help). (By doing this, you will be expressing gratitude to Allaah in a practical manner.)
v.s: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].

q: ...Speak about the favours of your Rabb
(out of some of gratitude to Allaah).
v.s: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
v.c: And proclaim the blessings of your Lord.
